purpose: Documentation-kit integrity only; not application proof
snapshot: Pre-implementation kit, as received before any code was written. The hashes below describe that received state and are deliberately NOT recomputed, so this file records what the kit originally contained.

superseded.note: The implementation changed some of these files. Their current contents are covered by proof/manifest.json, which hashes every tracked artefact at capture time and is regenerated by `npm run proof:export`.

filesRemovedSinceThisSnapshot.note: Two working documents from the received kit were deleted from the repository at the owner's request. They were process scaffolding rather than product documentation: one was the build prompt, the other the session handoff note. Their received hashes are preserved here so this file still describes the kit exactly as it arrived. Checkpoints C1 to C7 in docs/PROGRESS.md were written while those files existed, so they record facts and file names from that period; the two entries are left as written rather than rewritten, for the same reason the earlier checkpoints are.
